fusions.name: Stinging Grit
fusions.desc: You kick back 3 spreading sprays of stinging grit, each dealing 6 damage with a 30% chance of [Poisoned] for 6 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Carried Swarm
fusions.desc: A kick at a target up to 4 tiles away that deals 10 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full range. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Forager's Stint
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 8 seconds, and your movement speed rises 15% for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Never Idle
fusions.desc: Each time you spend stamina, a sting flies to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles, dealing 6 damage. Once every 3 seconds.
